 Diwali 2026 in Tamil Nadu: November 8 or 9? Check School, Bank and Government Office Holiday
 By Jasreet Kaur Last Updated: Nov 2, 2026, 13:24 IST Diwali 2026 falls on November 8 in Tamil Nadu, while November 9 is an additional state holiday. Check school, college, bank and government office holiday details.
 Diwali 2026 in Tamil Nadu: November 8 or 9? Check School, Bank and Government Office Holiday 
 Diwali is also known as Deepavali, will be celebrated on Sunday, November 8, 2026. However, the Tamil Nadu government has declared Monday, November 9 an additional holiday for government offices, public sector undertakings, schools, colleges and other educational institutions. Keep reading to know in detail.
 Diwali 2026: Important Dates in Tamil Nadu
 Date Day Occasion or Status 
 November 8, 2026 Sunday Diwali (Deepavali) 
 November 9, 2026 Monday Additional state holiday 
 November 28, 2026 Saturday Compensatory working day 
 Tamil Nadu Diwali Holiday 2026: School and College Status
 The state government has announced an additional holiday on November 9 for schools, colleges and other educational institutions covered by its order.
 Institution November 8 (Sunday) November 9 (Monday) November 28 (Saturday) 
 Government schools Sunday Holiday Working day 
 Private schools covered by the order Sunday Holiday Working day, as applicable under the order 
 Government colleges Sunday Holiday Working day 
 Other educational institutions covered by the order Sunday Holiday Working day 
 Tamil Nadu Diwali Holiday 2026: Government Office Status
 Government Institution November 8 November 9 November 28 
 State government offices Sunday Holiday Working day 
 Public sector undertakings covered by the order Sunday Holiday Working day 
 Treasuries and sub-treasuries Sunday Holiday, with arrangements for urgent work Working day 
 Are Banks Closed on November 8 and 9 in Tamil Nadu?
 The additional holiday announced by the Tamil Nadu government does not automatically apply to banks. Bank holidays are governed by the applicable banking holiday notification and the Reserve Bank of India’s holiday calendar.
 Date Day Bank Holiday Status 
 November 8, 2026 Sunday Banks closed as it is a Sunday 
 November 9, 2026 Monday Not automatically a bank holiday under the additional state order; check the RBI holiday calendar 
 November 28, 2026 Saturday Fourth Saturday; banks closed under the regular banking holiday schedule
